end.parentNote: Sameer practised place-value patterns for multiplying by 10, 100, and 1000, and used doubling and halving to estimate products. They explained that zeros go after the number and correctly worked through 25 × 36 as 900 using a quarter of 36. There was a mix-up while estimating 25 × 32, and it was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, practise a few examples by rewriting 25 as 100 ÷ 4 and then finding one-quarter of the other factor.
